defect.description: successful arm records persisted final_labels_hash, selected_algorithm and selected_configuration but not the final label vector, so the pre-frozen offline evaluation phase could not compute ARI from a finished run

discovery.note: discovered during Phase-C preparation, before any ground truth was loaded

contract_invariants: final_labels present for every successful arm
sha256 of the stored vector == final_labels_raw_hash
no successful arm may reach COMPLETE without the vector
recovery_rule: re-instantiate only the configuration the parent arm already selected; no search, policy resolution, CVI scoring, ranking or reranking is repeated. This is FINAL-PARTITION MATERIALIZATION, not scientific re-selection.
cryptographic_acceptance_rule: a reconstruction is migrated only if it reproduces the parent hash under the convention that arm recorded: raw label identity, or canonical partition identity where cluster ids may permute. Canonical equality is sufficient for ARI because relabelling does not change a partition. Approximate agreement and equal cluster count are rejected.
targeted_rerun_rule: reconstruct, verify, and fall back to a single frozen scientific execution only where verification fails or the parent produced no record. Algorithm names are never the rule. Outcomes and ARI play no part in choosing the set.

rerun_execution_policy.selection_difference_from_parent: recorded as provenance only; permitted by the frozen numerical policy

phase_a_parent_events.event: representation checksum mismatch during concurrent fetch
phase_a_parent_events.classification: type A transient retrieval; the dataset was re-verified afterwards and reproduces the frozen checksum 32c52259eeace2fc deterministically, so the frozen corpus is intact and the provenance gate correctly refused corrupted input

lesson: the Stage-4B-4 contract proved storage integrity but never proved that the downstream offline evaluator's required payload was persisted. A property-based gate now requires that every successful scientific result be directly evaluable offline with no scientific re-execution.
